en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 462 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ibn Mahbub from Abu Ayyub from Muhammad bin Muslim that he said:

“A caller will announce the name of Imam Qaim (a.s) from the sky, which will be heard by all the people of the world; which will awaken the sleeping ones; those who are standing will sit up and those who sit will stand up and this voice will be that of His Eminence, Jibraeel (a.s).”
